items.title: Scope required-environment checks to the current fork
items.reason: Changed wheel-coverage checks to intersect the current resolver fork. Shipped in uv 0.12.14, matching the reported regression boundary: non-Android wheels can no longer satisfy coverage in the Android fork. This change exposes the missing Android mapping; it did not implement that mapping.

items.title: Extend wheel filtering to Android tags
items.reason: Added Android-aware lockfile wheel filtering and lock_android, but did not update the resolver's implied_platform_markers. The test includes an sdist, which supplies universal coverage and masks the reported omission.

items.title: Enforce available distributions for supported environments
items.reason: Extended artifact-availability checks to tool.uv.environments as well as required-environments. This explains why both reproductions exercise coverage checks without explicitly setting required-environments; the current lock configuration combines both lists.

items.title: uv fails to find wheel for split index/dependency
items.reason: Closest analogous failure: existing FreeBSD wheels are rejected under required-environments because their tags lack marker mappings. A maintainer confirms that these mappings are manual. It concerns FreeBSD and split indexes, not the Android mapping or the uv 0.12.14 regression.

related.search_scope: Used authenticated gh to search open and closed issues and open, closed, and merged PRs. Separated Android wheel-only rejection from the fork-specific version regression; searched sherpa-onnx-core, Android/sdist, sys_platform, compatible-wheels errors, Unknown platform tag in wheel tag, implied_platform_markers, required-environments/forks, and 0.12.14. Broadened to wheel coverage, platform-marker inference, source-distribution absence, and historical fixes. PR search omitted known matches, so supplemented it with paginated PR title/body searches and direct inspection of linked PRs, comments, timelines, diffs, and release notes. Ruled out astral-sh/uv#9711 (accepting incomplete resolutions), astral-sh/uv#17178 (Termux marker availability), astral-sh/uv#19911 (Requires-Python metadata), astral-sh/uv#22716 (genuinely absent Windows dependency wheels), and astral-sh/uv#14040 with astral-sh/uv#14041 (fixed Windows AMD64 mapping). Android support in astral-sh/uv#8029 and astral-sh/uv#15646 concerns installation tags, not this resolver omission.

type_reason: The source confirms that implied_platform_markers omits Android, so Android wheels contribute no platform coverage; a compatible sdist masks the error. This incorrectly rejects available wheels. The reported regression from uv 0.12.13 to 0.12.14 aligns with astral-sh/uv#21672 and its release notes, although the reproductions were not executed. No existing item found tracks this Android failure closely enough to centralize it as a duplicate.
summary: astral-sh/uv#21672 explains the reported regression boundary, astral-sh/uv#14977 establishes the incomplete Android coverage, and astral-sh/uv#18451 explains the environments trigger. astral-sh/uv#17109 is a FreeBSD analogue. No exact duplicate found.
draft_response: Your diagnosis matches the resolver code: Android wheel tags are missing from implied_platform_markers, while a compatible sdist supplies coverage for every environment and masks the omission in lock_android. astral-sh/uv#14977 added Android lockfile filtering; astral-sh/uv#21672 made coverage checks apply within each fork in uv 0.12.14, consistent with your reported regression. These checks also apply to tool.uv.environments. The next step is to add the Android wheel-to-marker mapping and regression tests without an sdist for both the explicit Android environment and the dependency-fork example.
